caseNameFull: DIAMOND, COMMISSIONER OF PATENTS AND TRADEMARKS v. BRADLEY
attorneys: Deputy Solicitor General Wallace argued the cause for petitioner. With him on the briefs were Solicitor General McCree, Assistant Attorney General Litvack, Harriet S. Shapiro, Robert B. Nicholson, Frederic Freilicher, Joseph F. Nakamura, and Thomas E. Lynch., Nicholas Prasinos argued the cause for respondents. With him on the briefs were Faith F. Driscoll, Henry L. opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

The Chief Justice ..took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
